name: io.github.aksuyek/huetabig
title: hüt abig
description: Where films and series stream in Switzerland: services, age ratings, new arrivals, TV picks.

tools.name: search_titles
tools.description: Find a film or series among every title hüt abig ranks for Switzerland, by its English, German, French, Italian or original title, or by IMDb id (tt…). Returns each match's id (for where_to_watch and age_ratings), year, Overall score (0–10), the Swiss subscription streaming services that carry it and its huetabig.ch page.

query.description: A title, part of one, or an IMDb id (tt0133093).

type.description: movie for films, tv for series, all for both. Default all.

year.description: Release year (a year either side also matches).

language.description: Language of titles, service search links and page links: en, de, fr or it. Default en.

limit.description: How many titles to return, 1–25. Default 10.

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: Which Swiss subscription streaming services carry a film or series (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Apple TV, Sky, blue TV, Paramount+ and others), with a link to each, the date the services were checked, the Overall score (0–10) and the IMDb rating. Give the id from search_titles, or a title (with year and type to tell remakes apart). Subscription offers only: rentals, purchases and prices are not covered.

id.description: The title's id from search_titles (movie:603, tv:1396), an IMDb id (tt0903747) or a huetabig.ch title URL.

title.description: The title's name in English, German, French, Italian or the original language, when no id is known.

year.description: Release year, to tell remakes apart.

type.description: movie for films, tv for series, all for both. Default all.

language.description: Language of titles, service search links and page links: en, de, fr or it. Default en.

tools.name: top_titles
tools.description: The best-rated films and series by hüt abig's Overall score (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, TMDB and Oscars/Emmys combined), filtered as on huetabig.ch: type, genre, Swiss streaming service, origin country, original language and age band (kids, teens, adults). Each title comes with the Swiss services that carry it.

type.description: movie for films, tv for series, all for both. Default all.

service.description: A Swiss subscription service by name, e.g. Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Apple TV, Sky, blue TV, Paramount+, Play Suisse, MUBI.

origin_country.description: Production country with its own hüt abig collection: CH, TR, DE, AT, FR, GB, IT, GR, ES or PT.

original_language.description: Original language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. ko, ja, de, fr.

age.description: Age band, as the app's Kids, Teens and Adults filter reads the age rating.

language.description: Language of titles, service search links and page links: en, de, fr or it. Default en.

limit.description: How many titles to return, 1–25. Default 10.

tools.name: new_on_service
tools.description: What arrived on a Swiss subscription streaming service in the last 1–4 weeks, and which series got a new season there, from hüt abig's weekly Monday check of its ranked titles. Without a service, the arrivals across every Swiss service.

service.description: A Swiss subscription service by name, e.g. Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Sky. Leave out for all services.

weeks.description: How many weekly checks back, 1–4. Default 1 (the latest week).

type.description: movie for films, tv for series, all for both. Default all.

language.description: Language of titles, service search links and page links: en, de, fr or it. Default en.

limit.description: How many titles to return, 1–25. Default 15.

tools.name: tv_picks
tools.description: This week's best-rated films and series on Swiss public TV (SRF 1, SRF zwei, RTS 1, RTS 2, RSI LA 1, LA 2) at their first evening airing, and last week's still free on Play SRF, Play RTS or Play RSI. Programme data from SRG SSR (api.srgssr.ch); times are Swiss time.

channel.description: srf, rts or rsi for a broadcaster, or one channel (srf-1, srf-2, rts-1, rts-2, la-1, la-2).

from_date.description: Only airings on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD, Swiss time), e.g. today.

type.description: movie for films, tv for series, all for both. Default all.

language.description: Language of titles, service search links and page links: en, de, fr or it. Default en.

limit.description: How many titles to return, 1–25. Default 15.

tools.name: age_ratings
tools.description: A film's or series' age rating in Switzerland, Germany, Austria, France, Italy, the US and the UK, each in that market's own system (FSK 12, PG-13, 15, …), from TMDB's certifications, and the age band the hüt abig Kids/Teens/Adults filter reads from it. Give the id from search_titles, or a title.

id.description: The title's id from search_titles (movie:603, tv:1396), an IMDb id (tt0903747) or a huetabig.ch title URL.

title.description: The title's name in English, German, French, Italian or the original language, when no id is known.

year.description: Release year, to tell remakes apart.

type.description: movie for films, tv for series, all for both. Default all.

language.description: Language of titles, service search links and page links: en, de, fr or it. Default en.
